subject: 26 Bradley Road renovictions
overview: The Council approved several resolutions regarding financial transparency, waste management goals, and parking exemptions for essential workers. Residents of 26 Bradley Road provided extensive testimony regarding mass displacement and pending evictions following a building sale.

items.title: Finance Director Reporting Ordinance
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting a draft ordinance to mandate monthly presentations by the finance director to review warrant articles and revenue forecasts.

items.title: Essential Worker Parking Passes
items.summary: Approved a request for the Traffic Commission to establish parking passes for letter carriers and visiting nurses using personal vehicles, alongside an inquiry into the city's parking communication strategy.

items.title: Judgment Road Parking Signage
items.summary: Approved requesting the Traffic Commission to install parking restrictions on Judgment Road to mitigate vehicle displacement from adjacent areas.

items.title: Veterans Office Staffing and Services
items.summary: Approved a request for an update on the staffing status of the Veterans Office and a copy of the shared service contract with the town of Wilmington.

items.title: Solid Waste Task Force Update
items.summary: Approved a resolution seeking an update on the Solid Waste Task Force's progress toward zero-waste goals and an evaluation of current and future waste management contracts.

items.title: Mass Displacement at 26 Bradley Road
items.summary: Residents testified about receiving 30-day notices to vacate for building renovations; the Council pledged to connect tenants with legal aid and housing resources while noting statutory limitations on city intervention.

items.title: Reports of Committees
items.summary: Approved committee reports concerning Council rules of order and the proposed polystyrene ban, including an amendment setting the effective date for July 2023.

items.title: Adoption of Records
items.summary: The Council adopted the meeting records for March 22 and March 29, 2022.
